name: cache-meter
description: Claude Code mod: /keepwarm keeps your prompt cache alive through a break – /keepwarm auto through every break; a countdown, hit rate, context fill and API value above the prompt; what each answer cost; and a /tokens dashboard with what broke the cache, what fills your context, API errors and cost per hour.

cacheTtl.title: Cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto: derived from Claude Code's TTL controls (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, promptCacheTtl, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H), else 5m once a plan limit is used up, else the value reported on a model switch, else 60m. 60m/5m: fixed, wins over everything.

autoSidebar.title: Sidebar at start
autoSidebar.description: auto: in Claude Code's fullscreen renderer (/tui fullscreen), open the /tokens dashboard as a sidebar beside the chat at session start – placed from 144 terminal columns, 110 once you opened it yourself – and leave it closed once you close it. Never opens above the prompt by itself. off: only with /tokens.

turnLine.title: Line under each answer
turnLine.description: on: under each answer of the main conversation, one line with what it cost (API value on a subscription, spend otherwise; subagents it started included), its requests, how much came from the cache and how much was written to it. off: no line.

expiryNotice.title: Notification before the cache expires
expiryNotice.description: on: once per cache window, when about 10 minutes are left (17 % of the TTL) and keepwarm is off, a terminal notification through your own notification channel (Claude Code's preferredNotifChannel setting) – so you can still type /keepwarm. Only with a one-hour TTL and at least 10k tokens of context. off: none.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: on: in the docked dashboard (fullscreen renderer) a small café under the request chart acts out the cache – a barista sips while it is warm, watches the clock in the last stretch, naps once it is cold and tops up on a keepwarm ping. On the Overview the countdown flashes and its bar shines at each new minute, new request columns grow in, cost and saving count up, and the keepwarm arrow turns while it runs – each a fraction of a second, the café four frames a second, only while the Overview is on screen. The animation files get nothing but the cache's state. off: none of it.

limitNotice.title: Notification when a plan limit fills up
limitNotice.description: on: when a plan limit (5 hours, 7 days, spend limit) is at least half used and, at the pace since its window started (measured over at least 10 minutes), would be full before it resets, a terminal notification through your own notification channel (Claude Code's preferredNotifChannel setting) – once per limit window. The toast in Claude Code comes either way. off: the toast only.

sessionBudget.title: Session budget ($)
sessionBudget.description: 0 = off. Otherwise a dollar budget for one session, compared with the figure the band shows (spend on an API key, API value on a subscription): the band shows it as "of $X", turns yellow at 80 % and red at 100 %, and a toast appears once at each.
